contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-radar-account-risk-signals-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-radar-account-risk-signals-2026.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/radar/account-risk-signals`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/radar/account-risk-signals, a connected account's activity feeds Stripe's risk models, and Stripe notifies the platform backend when a signal is ready or changes. The backend fetches the signal and decides whether to review, pause or reject. November documents up to 90 days to retrieve signals and evaluations after creation, omits older account signals from lists, and adds the delinquency exposure estimate to fraudulent merchant, delinquency risk and fraudulent website (old raw lines 8-25; new raw lines 9-36). source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md summarizes May's three types and action choices. It needs the new overview fields and the distinction between ready notification and fetched resource. A signal does not itself establish fraud or execute an enforcement action.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/radar/account-risk-signals, the substantive November additions are the separate monetary exposure signal, 90-day lookup and list boundary, and explicit notification followed by resource retrieval (old raw lines 8-25; new raw lines 9-36). The duplicate signal list was consolidated and the action table was replaced with the account fraud prevention route and a diagram. Preserve May's versioned preview link, website on-demand detail, and six scoped Radar for Platforms actions in source-stripe-radar-account-risk-signals.md (old raw lines 19-40; new raw lines 23-36). Retain reciprocal Radar and Platforms routes and the distinct action and signal detail links. November child evidence qualifies old webhook payload and event/endpoint claims and plan or access boundaries, with neither universal eligibility nor full details on every webhook established by the overview.

concept_targets.scope: Audit relevant sections first; only bounded evidence-backed reciprocal corrections in final reviewed findings. No unrelated rewrite.
